label: Pro 2.1.0
title: A web inbox and a watchdog
lede: Pro 2.1.0 adds a web inbox for withdrawal and cancellation cases and continuous monitoring of your sites. Both are in beta.

items.title: Web inbox for your cases
items.text: Lists withdrawals and cancellations with status and refund day, marks overdue ones, changes the status in the ledger chain and sends a reply from a German or English template.

items.title: Inbox inside your own server
items.text: Use the same inbox from code. Replies go out through any transport of inverse-mail, and inboxHandler lets you mount it in your own server.

items.title: Watch your sites for regressions
items.text: Each run checks your sites and reports only changes: a button that vanished, a site that stays broken, a site that is back. Alerts go to a webhook.

items.title: Generate the GitHub Actions workflow
items.text: Prints a workflow that runs the watch on a schedule and fails the run on an alert, so GitHub notifies you by mail.

note: The demo cannot show these: the inbox needs your own ledger and server (HTTPS in front of it), and the watch needs your own sites and a scheduler. Mail delivery through real providers and the generated workflow on a real GitHub runner are not yet tested against live systems.
